title: Fernhill Annual Report 2026
summary: This report reviews Fernhill Outdoor Co.’s 2026 financial performance, strategy, product segments, operations, sustainability, governance, and key risks, with comparisons to 2025 and plans for 2027. It can answer questions about revenue, margins, cash flow, segment and regional performance, store and workforce operations, environmental and supplier practices, board and executive compensation, and risk mitigations. Tables are noted in the at-a-glance financial comparison, sustainability emissions comparison, and director roster; the report also covers 2028 strategic and sustainability targets and 2027 forecasts and investments.

title: Fernhill Employee Handbook
summary: This handbook explains workplace policies and employee support at fictional Fernhill Outdoor Co. for staff in offices, distribution centres, and stores; contracts and local law take priority if they differ. Its sections cover joining and development, working hours and locations, leave, pay and benefits, expenses and travel, equipment and security, conduct and reporting concerns, and leaving Fernhill. It can help employees find guidance on eligibility, approvals, procedures, deadlines, and responsibilities across these topics; no tables or images are mentioned.
